item.title: Notify NYC - Road Reopened - Brooklyn Queens Expressway (BK)
item.description:

item.title: Notify NYC - Portal North Bridge Planned Work - NJ Transit
item.description:
Notification issued 10-13-2026 at 11:12 AM.
Due to planned work on the Portal North Bridge, service on all NJ Transit rail lines except the Atlantic City Rail Line (ACRL) will experience temporary schedule adjustments. All weekday Midtown Direct trains on the Morris & Essex (M&E), Gladstone Branch and Montclair-Boonton Line will be diverted to Hoboken. Weekend Midtown Direct trains will operate to/from PSNY. Regular schedules are expected to resume on Sunday, November 15th.
Customers are asked to check schedules before traveling and allow for extra travel time. Those with the ability to work from home are encouraged to do so.
For more information on the project, please visit https://www.njtransit.com/portalcutover
item.author: NYCEM [English]

item.title: Notify NYC - Reapertura
item.description: Luego del cierre de carretera que se informó anteriormente en el área de Van Wyck Expwy y Atlantic Ave en Queens, todos los carriles se han abierto en su área. Puede haber demoras residuales.

item.title: Notify NYC - Открытие дороги
